notes.upstream: > 🌐 [English](#english) | [中文](#中文) ## English This release adds support for the new Bambu Lab P3C printer and mixed nozzle diameters on the H2D, plus performance and usability improvements and fixes for several issues affecting print quality and stability. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) The Flathub version is maintained by [@hadess](https://github.com/hadess) ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. ## New Features ### Added Support for Bambu Lab P3C Studio now supports the Bambu Lab P3C multi-nozzle 3D printer. It can carry up to seven print heads at the same time, and each print head has its own independent feeding and heating system. Filament therefore stays loaded at all times and can be preheated in advance, so a relay print between two filaments can be completed in as little as 6 seconds. ### Added Support for H2D Mixed Nozzle Diameter Printing (incl. Filament Track Switch) Multi-diameter slicing and printing on the H2D, including scenarios that use the Filament Track Switch. Within a single model, you can assign nozzles of different diameters to local details and to the main body, so each diameter prints at its own suitable layer height: the smaller nozzle handles details such as text and scales, while the larger nozzle prints the main body quickly. What sets Bambu Studio's multi-diameter feature apart from other slicers is that it is built on a deeply refactored the slicing engine, which delivers a level of freedom no other slicer offers: - Full-range mixing: it supports not only different nozzle diameters, but more importantly, each diameter paired with its own layer height. - Free per-region assignment: not limited to walls and infill. You can assign nozzles freely to different regions of a model according to how much detail each region needs, taking the freedom of multi-diameter combinations to the fullest. For details on using multiple nozzle diameters, see [wiki.](https://wiki.bambulab.com/h3c/manual/mixed-nozzle-size-printing) > Notes on H2C, X2D, and other models: Model support is a process, and we are working hard on it. Support will arrive no later than the date published in the [official announcement.](https://blog.bambulab.com/h2d-h2c-and-x2d-will-support-hybrid-printing-with-multi-orifice-nozzles/) Thank you for your patience, and stay tuned for updates. ### Other New Features - Sparse infill density now accepts decimal values [#12513](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12513) . - New cross-part color penetration option: allows color painted on a part's top and bottom surfaces to penetrate into adjacent parts. When disabled, color penetration will not reach adjacent parts. ([#8642](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/8642)） - New mouse rotation sensitivity preference: the 3D view's rotation sensitivity can now be adjusted in Preferences [#6520](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/6520) . - Split selected parts into new objects: after selecting one or more parts, they can be split into independent objects. - The post-slicing preview now shows the nozzle and filament used for each move. - The post-slicing preview now reports the print time of each filament. Each filament's estimated print time is now shown separately. ## Improvements ### Improvements to the Filament Selection Dialog On the Device page, the AMS filament selection now shows each spool's note directly and marks the filament currently in use together with its location, making it easier to tell filaments apart when choosing one. ### **Improved the Simplify Model Dialog** Improved interaction on the Simplify model page. The simplification methods are now separated, so each keeps its own level, making them easier to use. Keep all painting is now enabled by default to prevent color loss when simplifying a model. ### Improved seam placement on multi-color models Seams now prefer positions that stay hidden deeper inside the color region after the seam, keeping the seam start away from exposed surfaces and reducing defects caused by unstable nozzle pressure after a long travel. Before After ### Other Improvements - AMS filament settings on the Device page now show the color name and hex value, making them easier to identify ([#12812](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12812)). Thanks to @[longrackslabs](https://github.com/longrackslabs) - Added a warning that the printer produces noticeable vibration and noise when the infill pattern is 3D Honeycomb, Honeycomb or Gyroid and the acceleration is set high. It is recommended to reduce the infill acceleration. - Improved printing connections: when sending via the cloud fails, the app now automatically falls back to a direct LAN connection, reducing send failures. - Improved visability of the colors and borders of the AMS slot remaining-filament progress bar for clearer readings. - Improved app startup and UI responsiveness. - Improved support parameters for multi-diameter printing: Top Z distance and Bottom Z distance can now be edited. - Improved normal supports and classic tree supports algorithms, reducing slicing wait times for models with complex support structures and many support faces. - For Bambu Lab H3C & P3C in single-diameter mode, the first-layer infill line width with a 0.2 mm nozzle is now 0.6 mm, improving first-layer adhesion and quality. - The manual flush volume limit for multi-color printing has been raised to 2000 mm³. The actual flush volume is subject to printer firmware limitations; please refer to firmware release notes for supported flush volumes. ## Bug Fixes 1. Fixed STEP import hanging when OK is disabled in the mesh parameters dialog ([#13103](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/13103)). Thanks to [edg2s](https://github.com/edg2s). 2. Fixed ASCII reading of zero normals in binary STL files ([#12963](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12963)). Thanks to [aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi). 3. Fixed incorrect print position when identical objects share slicing layers ([#12861](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12861)). Thanks to [aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi). 4. Fixed tree supports getting stuck on repeated overhang polygons in multi-diameter mode ([#13060](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/13060)). Thanks to [mattlyle](https://github.com/mattlyle). 5. Fixed some compilation issues ([#12975](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12975)). Thanks to [hadess](https://github.com/hadess). 6. Fixed G-code conflict detection to check all instances ([#12862](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12862), [#12863](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12863)). Thanks to [aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi). 7. Fixed a crash on Linux when clicking "Download and Open" ([#13063](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/13063)). Thanks to [sproctor](https://github.com/sproctor). 8. Fixed compatibility issues in the preset comparison dialog ([#12843](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12843)). Thanks to [flavioheleno](https://github.com/flavioheleno). 9. Fixed failure to start on Linux ([#12925](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12925)). Thanks to [freasy](https://github.com/freasy). 10. Fixed the CLI being unable to exit because it waits for the backup thread ([#12875](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12875)). Thanks to [aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi). 11. Added a Show Log Folder entry to the Help menu ([#11493](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11493)). Thanks to [BenJule](https://github.com/BenJule). 12. The preview page now supports per-object coloring: different objects of the same model can be distinguished in the preview. This must be enabled in Preferences. Thanks to [Miquelsn](https://github.com/Miquelsn). 13. The CLI option for the wipe tower rotation angle is temporarily unsupported pending further improvement. Thanks [andeplane](https://github.com/andeplane) for raising this issue. 14. Fixed failure to convert to other languages on the Send to Print page. [#13122](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13122) 15. Fixed the OK button being unavailable while the face count is still being calculated for STEP files. [#13113](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13113) [#13080](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13080) 。 16. Fixed shrinkage compensation being incorrectly disabled for single-color painted objects. [#13029](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13029) 。 17. Fixed a crash in boolean operations. [#13026](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13026)。 18. Fixed nozzle temperature being reset after the first layer, overriding manual adjustments. [#13012](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13012)。 19. Fixed nozzle selection not taking effect on the H2C. 20. Fixed the prime tower being unable to move to the edge of the plate. [#12995](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12995)[#13146](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13146)。 21. Fixed the left and right nozzles being displayed in reverse on the H2C. [#12933](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12933)。 22. Fixed HMS not being displayed. [#12935](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12935)。 23. Fixed the file name always showing as "untitled" when opening an external 3MF by double-clicking. [#12943](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12943)。 24. Fixed an abnormal dialog causing the account to be logged out. [#12746](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12746)。 25. Fixed the inability to delete height range modifiers on macOS.[#12739](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12739)。 26. Fixed the remaining amount showing as 0 after adding a filament manager to an external spool.[#13014](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13014)。 27. Fixed mesh boolean operations crashing or hanging with coplanar inputs. 28. Fixed occasional crashes of Liveview on the Device page. 29. Fixed model geometry being lost after import for some 3MF files due to invalid project configuration. 30. Fixed some page compatibility issues on macOS, Linux and multi-monitor setups. 31. Restored the unit conversion dialog when importing objects. [#13280](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13280) [#12929](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12929) ## Known Issues - Multi-diameter mixed printing is still being refined; in some combinations, the estimated support and wipe tower dimensions may differ from the actual print result. - Helio support for H2D multi-diameter is not yet complete. The Helio team will add H2D multi-diameter support as soon as possible. - On the P3C, the status of the optional drying module's power adapter is currently determined by firmware, and the software does not yet provide a pre-check. Starting drying without the drying adapter connected may result in no response. - When slicing with ABS on the X2D, the filter fan command in the start G-code is misidentified as the auxiliary fan command, so the auxiliary fan speed is incorrectly shown as 100% in the G-code preview. This affects the preview display only; actual printing is not affected. It will be resolved in a later preset file update. - Bambu Studio may fail to launch on Windows 11 when Smart App Control is enabled (v02.09.02.62) - **Symptom**: After updating to this version, some Windows 11 users see a "bambu-studio.exe - Bad Image" error pointing to libmpfr-4.dll in the installation folder, with error code 0xC0E90002, and the app does not start. - **Cause**: The libmpfr-4.dll and libgmp-10.dll shipped with this build are not digitally signed. When Windows 11 Smart App Control is set to On or Evaluation, it blocks unsigned DLLs from loading, which triggers the error above. - **Workaround**: Replace the DLLs in the installation folder with signed versions; see the instructions below: - Extract `signed_dll.rar` to obtain the two files: `libmpfr-4.dll` and `libgmp-10.dll`. - Close Bambu Studio if it is currently running, then copy the two files to the Studio installation directory. The default path is `C:\Program Files\Bambu Studio`, but the actual path depends on the installation location selected by the user. - If prompted to replace files with the same name, choose **Replace**. Once the replacement is complete, reopen Bambu Studio. - A future release will ship signed dependencies, after which no manual replacement is needed. --- ## 中文 本次 Bambu Studio 版本更新新增对拓竹新品 P3C 打印机的支持，同时支持H2D多口径混合打印，并带来多项软件性能与体验优化，修复了若干影响打印质量与稳定性的问题。 您可以从 [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) 上下载适用于 Linux 的 Flathub 版本。 Flathub 版本由 [@hadess](https://github.com/hadess) 维护。感谢他为此付出的出色工作 ## 新功能 ### 支持拓竹P3C 打印机 支持拓竹P3C 多喷头3D打印机，最多可同时装载 7 个打印头。每个打印头都有独立的进料与加热系统，让耗材始终处于装载状态，并可主动预热，最快 6 秒内完成两种耗材的接力打印。 ### H2D 支持多口径混合打印(包括选料器场景) 支持H2D的多口径切片和打印，包含选料器场景，在同一模型中可为局部细节和主体指定不同口径的喷嘴，让不同口径采用各自合适的层高打印：小口径负责文字与刻度等细节，大口径负责快速打印主体 另外，不同于其他切片软件的多口径功能，BambuStudio 基于切片引擎深度重构，带来了独树一帜的自由度方案： - 全尺寸混搭：不仅支持不同口径，更重要的是支持不同口径匹配不同层高。 - 区域自由定制：不仅限于墙和填充，用户也可对模型不同精细度的外观区域自由指定喷嘴，将多口径组合的自由度发挥到极致。 多口径的使用方法可[参考wiki](https://wiki.bambulab.com/zh/h3c/manual/mixed-nozzle-size-printing) > H2C、X2D 等机型适配说明：机型的适配需要一个过程，我们正在全力推进。适配时间最晚不晚于[官方公告](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/C1DNh4_YXBhanpIjvJhMXQ)中公布的时间节点，请大家耐心等待，并持续关注后续更新公告。 ### 其他新功能 - 稀疏填充密度支持小数点输入 [#12513](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12513)。 - 新增跨零件涂色渗透参数：允许颜色从该零件涂色的顶面和底面渗透到相邻零件中。关闭时,涂色渗透将不会到达相邻零件。([#8642](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/8642)） - 新增鼠标旋转灵敏度偏好设置：可在偏好设置中调整三维视图的旋转灵敏度 [#6520](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/6520)。 - 支持将选中零件拆分为新对象：选中一个或多个零件后可一键拆分为独立对象。 - 切片预览支持逐段查看喷嘴与耗材信息。 - 切片后预览新增统计每根耗材的打印耗时，新增不同耗材单独显示预计的打印时间。 ## 优化与改进 ### 添加耗材时的选择对话框多项改进 设备页AMS耗材选择处直接显示料盘的备注信息，标记当前正在使用的耗材与位置，便于选择耗材时区分 ### 优化模型简化页面的交互 优化模型简化页面的交互，将不同的简化方式拆开独立使用简化等级，方便用户使用，同时默认开启保留所有绘制，防止简化模型导致色彩丢失 ### 优化多色模型的接缝位置 优先选择其后隐藏于色块内更远的位置，使接缝的起点远离外表面，减少因长距离空驶后，熔融区压力不稳定引起的外表面瑕疵。 优化前 优化后 ### 其他优化项 - 设备页AMS耗材设置显示颜色名称与色值，便于分辨 [#12812](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12812) 感谢 @[longrackslabs](https://github.com/longrackslabs) 。 - 新增当填充图案为 3D 蜂窝、蜂窝或螺旋，且加速度设定较高时，打印机可能产生明显的振动与噪声提示。 - 公网打印连接方式优化：云端发送失败时会自动尝试局域网直连，减少因云端异常导致的发送失败。 - 优化了 AMS 槽位余量进度条的配色与边框，读数更清晰。 - 优化软件启动与界面响应速度。 - 优化多口径下的支撑参数，支撑顶 / 底 Z 间距支持编辑。 - 优化普通支撑与经典树状支撑的生成算法。对于支撑结构复杂、支撑面较多的模型，减少切片时间的等待。 - Bambu Lab H3C&P3C机型单口径模式0.2mm喷嘴的首层填充线宽改为0.6mm，提升首层附着力，改善质量。 - 多色打印的冲刷量手动修改上限已提升至 2000 mm³。实际冲刷量受打印机固件限制，支持的冲刷量请参阅固件发布说明。 ## Bug 修复 1. 修复网格参数对话框中禁用“确定”时，STEP 导入卡死 [#13103](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/13103) 感谢[edg2s](https://github.com/edg2s)。 2. 修复二进制STL中零法线的ASCII读取 [#12963](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12963) 感谢[aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi)。 3. 修复相同对象共享切片图层时打印位置错误的问题 [#12861](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12861) 感谢[aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi)。 4. 修复：在多直径模式下，树状支撑在重复悬垂多边形时卡住 [#13060](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/13060) 感谢[mattlyle](https://github.com/mattlyle)。 5. 修复一些编译问题 [#12975](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12975) 感谢[hadess](https://github.com/hadess)。 6. 修复检查 G-code 冲突检测问题，改为检查所有的实例 [#12862](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12862) [#12863](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12863) 感谢[aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi)。 7. 修复Linux 在点击“下载并打开”时崩溃问题 [#13063](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/13063) 感谢[sproctor](https://github.com/sproctor)。 8. 修复预设比较弹窗兼容性问题 [#12843](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12843) 感谢[flavioheleno](https://github.com/flavioheleno)。 9. 修复Linux上无法启动的问题 [#12925](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12925) 感谢[freasy](https://github.com/freasy)。 10. 修复CLI由于等待备份线程导致命令行无法退出问题 [#12875](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12875) 感谢[aklipi](https://github.com/aklipi)。 11. 帮助菜单新增日志文件夹入口 [#11493](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11493) 感谢[BenJule](https://github.com/BenJule)。 12. 预览页支持按对象独立着色：可在预览中区分同一模型的不同对象,需要在偏好设置中开启使用 。感谢[Miquelsn](https://github.com/Miquelsn)。 13. CLI命令行擦料塔旋转角度功能暂改为不支持，等待后续优化 感谢 [andeplane](https://github.com/andeplane) 。 14. 修复发送打印页转化小语种失败问题 [#13122](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13122)。 15. 修复step文件时计算面片数目不可点击确认的问题 [#13113](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13113) [#13080](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13080) 。 16. 修复单色涂色对象收缩补偿被误禁用 [#13029](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13029) 。 17. 修复布尔运算闪退问题 [#13026](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13026)。 18. 修复首层后重复设置喷嘴温度覆盖手动调整的问题 [#13012](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13012)。 19. 修复H2C选择喷嘴不生效的问题。 20. 修复料塔无法移动至盘边缘的问题 [#12995](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12995)[#13146](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13146)。 21. 修复H2C左右喷嘴显示反了的问题 [#12933](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12933)。 22. 修复HMS不显示的问题 [#12935](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12935)。 23. 修复双击打开外部 3MF 时文件名始终显示 untitled 的问题 [#12943](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12943)。 24. 修复异常弹窗导致账号退出登录的问题 [#12746](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12746)。 25. 修复mac上无法删除高度范围修改器的问题 [#12739](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12739)。 26. 修复外挂料盘添加耗材管理器后余量显示为0的问题 [#13014](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13014)。 27. 修复网格布尔运算在共面输入时崩溃或卡死的问题。 28. 修复设备页 Liveview 偶发崩溃的问题。 29. 修复部分 3MF 因项目配置非法导致导入后模型几何丢失的问题。 30. 修复mac、linux与多显示器环境中页面一些兼容性问题。 32. 恢复零件导入时单位转换弹窗 [#13280](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/13280) [#12929](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12929)。 ## 已知问题 - 多口径混合打印仍在持续完善，部分组合下支撑与擦料塔的尺寸估算可能与实际打印结果存在偏差。 - H2D 多口径下 Helio 功能暂不完善，Helio 团队将会尽快支持 H2D 的多口径功能。 - P3C 选配烘干模块目前由固件判断电源适配器状态，软件侧尚未提供前置拦截，未接烘干适配器时发起烘干可能无响应。 - X2D 使用 ABS 耗材切片时，起始段 G-code 中的过滤风扇指令被误识别为辅助风扇指令，导致 G-code 预览中辅助风扇转速被错误显示成 100%。此问题仅影响预览显示，不影响实际打印，将在后续通过预设文件更新解决。 - Windows 11 开启"智能应用控制（Smart App Control）"时，Bambu Studio 可能无法启动（v02.09.02.62） - **现象**：更新到该版本后，部分 Windows 11 用户双击启动时会弹出 "bambu-studio.exe - Bad Image" 错误，提示文件为安装目录下的 libmpfr-4.dll，错误代码 0xC0E90002，程序无法打开。 - **原因**：该版本随包分发的 libmpfr-4.dll、libgmp-10.dll 未进行数字签名。Windows 11 的智能应用控制（Smart App Control）处于"开启"或"评估"模式时，会阻止未签名 DLL 加载，从而出现上述报错。 - **临时解决方案**：使用签名版本的 DLL 替换安装目录中的同名文件，操作步骤如下： - 解压缩 `signed_dll.rar`，得到 `libmpfr-4.dll` 和 `libgmp-10.dll` 这两个文件。 - 关闭正在运行中的 Bambu Studio 软件，把上面两个文件拷贝到 Studio 的安装目录下。默认是 `C:\Program Files\Bambu Studio`，实际看用户自己选的安装路径。 - 提示是否替换同名文件时，选择**替换**。替换后重新打开 Bambu Studio 即可。 - 后续版本将提供已签名的依赖库，届时无需再手动替换。
